faqs.a: Manufacturer specifications: continuous flow 0.5–5 L/min, oxygen concentration 93% ±3%, sound ≤40 dB(A), weight 13 kg. The confirmed electrical rating is 320 W; this is not an HHZ consumption measurement.

faqs.q: What warranty and box contents are confirmed?
faqs.a: Warranty is 3 years or 10,000 operating hours, whichever comes first. Confirmed inclusions are a nebulizer kit, fitted filter and one extra HEPA filter. Other box contents and quantities remain pending; obtain written terms and package details.

description_text: Home Medix HM-KV is a stationary continuous-flow oxygen concentrator with manufacturer-published 0.5–5 L/min flow, 93% ±3% oxygen concentration, ≤40 dB(A) sound, 320 W rated power and 13 kg weight. Manufacturer-published price checked 28 October 2026: ₹42,000 before 5% GST, ₹44,100 including GST. Warranty is 3 years or 10,000 operating hours, whichever comes first. No HHZ bench test is claimed.
